events.label: Vatican schedules conference on implementation of The Joy of Love

slots.name: number of participants
slots.sentence: On Friday, Vatican officials said it would be up to the 187 participants whether specific points of Francis’ document would be discussed and how, insisting there was no prewritten final document.

slots.name: dates
slots.sentence: The Rev. Giacomo Costa, of the Vatican’s synod office, said the Oct. 7-14 meeting was not a continuation of the synod on the family that provided the consultation leading to Francis’ text or a chance to rewrite it.
